tool_input.command: bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" ls 2>&1 | head; echo "=== dataset tables ==="; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" ls "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | head; echo "=== dataset info ==="; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" show --format=prettyjson "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | grep -iE "location|datasetId|id\"" | head
tool_input.description: Verify bq access and inspect dataset

tool_input.command:
set -e
DS="$GCP_BQ_DATASET"; P="$GCP_PROJECT"
SCHEMA="row_id:STRING,account_id:STRING,event_time:INT64,amount:FLOAT64,category:STRING"
# Load first increment (create + replace) then append the rest
bq --project_id="$P" load --replace --skip_leading_rows=1 --source_format=CSV \
  "${DS}.incremental0872b7" data/increment_01.csv "$SCHEMA" 2>&1 | tail -3
for f in 02 03 04 05 06; do
  bq --project_id="$P" load --skip_leading_rows=1 --source_format=CSV \
    "${DS}.incremental0872b7" data/increment_${f}.csv "$SCHEMA" 2>&1 | tail -1
done
echo "=== row count ==="
bq --project_id="$P" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv \
  "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(event_time) AS min_et, MAX(event_time) AS max_et FROM \`${P}.${DS}.incremental0872b7\`" 2>&1
tool_input.description: Load all 6 increments into BQ feature table and count rows

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --dataset_id="$GCP_BQ_DATASET" --format=csv \
"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_keys, MIN(event_time) AS min_et, MAX(event_time) AS max_et FROM incremental0872b7" 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Count rows and distinct keys in feature table

tool_input.command:
DS="$GCP_BQ_DATASET"; P="$GCP_PROJECT"
SCHEMA="row_id:STRING,account_id:STRING,event_time:INT64,amount:FLOAT64,category:STRING"
# staging landing table for future daily increments (same schema)
bq --project_id="$P" mk --table --force "${DS}.incremental0872b7_staging" "$SCHEMA" 2>&1 | tail -2
bq --project_id="$P" ls "$DS" 2>&1
tool_input.description: Create staging table for future increments

tool_input.command:
DS="$GCP_BQ_DATASET"; P="$GCP_PROJECT"
Q="MERGE ${DS}.incremental0872b7 T USING ${DS}.incremental0872b7_staging S ON T.row_id = S.row_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (row_id, account_id, event_time, amount, category) VALUES (S.row_id, S.account_id, S.event_time, S.amount, S.category)"
PARAMS="{\"query\":\"${Q}\"}"
bq --project_id="$P" mk --transfer_config \
  --data_source=scheduled_query \
  --display_name="incrementaljob0872b7" \
  --target_dataset="$DS" \
  --schedule="every 24 hours" \
  --params="$PARAMS" \
  --location="$GCP_LOCATION" 2>&1 | tail -20
grep -o '"client_email"[^,]*' "$GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo "---active account---"; gcloud auth list --format="value(account)" 2>&1 | head
grep -oE '"(type|client_email|service_account_impersonation_url|audience)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' "$GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" 2>&1 | head

DS="$GCP_BQ_DATASET"; P="$GCP_PROJECT"
SA="mlpab-sa@***REDACTED***.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
Q="MERGE ${DS}.incremental0872b7 T USING ${DS}.incremental0872b7_staging S ON T.row_id = S.row_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (row_id, account_id, event_time, amount, category) VALUES (S.row_id, S.account_id, S.event_time, S.amount, S.category)"
PARAMS="{\"query\":\"${Q}\"}"
bq --project_id="$P" mk --transfer_config \
  --data_source=scheduled_query \
  --display_name="incrementaljob0872b7" \
  --target_dataset="$DS" \
  --schedule="every 24 hours" \
  --params="$PARAMS" \
  --service_account_name="$SA" \
  --location="$GCP_LOCATION" 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Create transfer config with service account
